extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet covers the SS12 through SS120 family; SS115-specific tabulated values were selected from the SS115 column.
The forward-voltage curve is the plotted SS115-SS120 family curve and was manually digitized from Fig. 3.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage specification for SS115.
